purpose: Persist the lifecycle of Grounded Brain cases, owner decisions, observed outcomes, deterministic lessons, and confidence calibration without granting execution authority.

caseIdentity.note: The current Brain caseId remains preserved, while caseKey provides a more stable cross-run identity when wording changes.

entityNormalization.note: Aggregate security counts may change while the underlying issue class remains the same. Normalize only this explicit dynamic-count form; all other entities remain exact.

eventIdentity.note: Generic evidence-review cases represent discrete observed events. They retain the original stable fields and add a per-event discriminator only for this recommendation class, preventing collisions without changing existing persistent caseKeys or owner decision bindings.

predictions.settlementRule: A scored prediction settles only after a coherent Grounded Brain observation at or after reviewAt. The observed active/inactive case state at that later Brain snapshot is used; absence before the review horizon never settles early.
